resources.string: The garden at the Asylum at Saint-Remy
Painting "Sunflowers" by Vincent van Gogh. A vase with vibrant yellow sunflowers on a table. Oil on canvas, 1889.
Painting "Dr Paul Gachet" by Vincent van Gogh. A portrait of a man with a melancholic expression, wearing a blue jacket and resting his head on his hand. Oil on canvas, 1890.
Painting "Starry Night" by Vincent van Gogh. A night sky with swirling blue clouds, bright stars, and a crescent moon over a quiet village and a dark cypress tree. Oil on canvas, 1889.
Painting "The garden at the Asylum at Saint-Remy" by Vincent van Gogh. A lush garden with winding paths, tall trees, and vibrant flowers. Oil on canvas, 1889.
